name: KyberSwap
classificationNote: Classified by keyword rules from the SlowMist label and description.
rootCause: KyberSwap, a DEX aggregator and liquidity platform, tweeted that they discovered a potential loophole in KyberSwap Elastic, and hoped that liquidity providers could extract liquidity as soon as possible. No user assets have been lost so far.
